prior_findings.title: Trusted scripts-integration ledger failure does not reproduce on the test-merge checkout
prior_findings.scenario: The trusted evidence ledger records scripts-integration as failed: TestWukongIMThreeNodeLocalE2EBuildUsesSelectedWorktreeRevision built a binary missing vcs.revision=35c6d34f9b181caaa46fffb173814c1ada2671af. Re-running the exact protected command (go test -tags=integration ./scripts/... -count=1 -timeout=9m -parallel=2) and the single test on the identical test-merge checkout passes, and the emitted build command stamps vcs.revision correctly.
prior_findings.impact: A mandatory check is recorded failed in trusted evidence while the identical re-run passes, leaving the ledger outcome unexplained (candidate non-merge or environment-sensitive stamping behavior, or environment state during the ledger run).
evidence: Advisory re-run: GOWORK=off go test -tags=integration ./scripts/... -count=1 -timeout=9m -parallel=2 -> ok github.com/WuKongIM/WuKongIM/scripts 93.583s
Advisory re-run of the single failing test -> PASS (4.19s)

prior_findings.resolution: Re-run the protected scripts-integration check via the check ledger; if it passes, the failure was environmental and this advisory can be dropped.
